title: HtmlObject
responsibility: Renders the native object element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlObject.attributes
inputs.description: Native object attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlObject.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native object element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlObject
outputs.description: The actual native object element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
